product.name: WebCited
product.description: WebCited shows where AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot) cite or ignore your website, then generates specific technical fixes (llms.txt, schema markup, comparison pages) to improve your visibility in AI answers — and re-probes the engines to prove the fixes worked. First scan is free, no card required.
product.genre: AI search optimization / SEO / marketing tools for SaaS

targeting.idealProspect: Founders or growth/marketing leads of newly launched B2B SaaS or web products with a public marketing website, who care about being discovered — traffic, SEO, distribution. They just launched, so being cited by ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI Overviews when buyers ask for tools in their category is directly valuable. Bad fits: hardware, mobile-only apps with no real website, open-source libs with no commercial site, products whose site is just a waitlist page.
